# Offline display fixtures — v0.5.6 platform aggregation

`input.json` is a six-check access fixture, not a real measurement.
`upstream-*.golden` preserve geocheck v0.3.0 for provenance.
`english-positive.golden` / `english-negative.golden` remain the historical
published-v0.5.5 row-per-measurement snapshots, unchanged. They are NOT current
platform-row output and were not falsely regenerated by hand or by running Go.

`platform-positive.json` / `platform-negative.json` are hand-authored exact
logical Service/Result/Region cells for the23 core-platform English fixture,
not renderer screenshots or live platform observations. Search raw captcha yes -> No;
Legacy signup is Unknown unless the fixture expressly represents scoped refusal.
Each Web/API/sample status stays separate; country-only rows say Region/Store
region, multiple source countries are qualified, failed expected geo stays
Unknown, and API deployments do not invent countries.

`english_results_test.go` compares all exact platform cells and profile text,
retaining whole-word ANSI colour assertions. Full frame/column/width and
14–160-column per-cell lossless reconstruction remain in three_columns_test.go,
single_box_test.go and the existing real-loopback PTY regression source.
`catalogue_test.go` covers all168 mapped measurements, all145 unique platforms,
six purposes, all16 consolidated families, nine safety Unknowns, retained
Bilibili samples, distinct products and unknown caller fallbacks.
`platforms_test.go` covers conflicting states, source countries/errors/no
backfill, optional extra fields, Qwen deployments and all11 selection counts.
Root single_box_test.go preserves unchanged report JSON and compares normal
terminal and machine.terminal from the same supplied measurements. Physical
wrapped lines/status bullets are not measurement or platform counts.

Current offline/loopback execution results are recorded in the v0.5.6 Release.
Authored expectations are not fabricated runtime screenshots. Historical
v0.5.5 golden output remains provenance, not current-platform output.
